test.title: A later start to the school day

paragraphs.text: In 2019 a secondary school in the north of England moved the start of its day from 8.30 to 9.40 for a two-year trial. The head teacher, Joanne Reid, had read research suggesting that teenagers’ body clocks shift during puberty, making it hard for them to fall asleep before 11 pm.
paragraphs.label: A

paragraphs.text: The school kept the length of the day the same, so lessons now finish at 4.30 instead of 3.20. Sports clubs that used to meet after school were moved to the lunch break, which was made twenty minutes longer.
paragraphs.label: B

paragraphs.text: At the end of the first year, attendance had risen from 91 to 94 per cent, and fewer pupils were late for the first lesson. Exam results in mathematics improved slightly, but results in other subjects stayed almost unchanged, and Reid warned that one year was too short to draw firm conclusions.
paragraphs.label: C

paragraphs.text: Not everyone welcomed the change. Some parents who start work early found it difficult to arrange for their children to get to school, and a nearby primary school, which kept its 8.45 start, reported that older brothers and sisters could no longer walk younger children to the gate.
paragraphs.label: D

document.title: A later start to the school day

items.prompt: The trial was planned to last for two years.

explanation.en: “for a two-year trial” — the trial was designed for two years. The statement says the same in other words → TRUE.
explanation.kk: «for a two-year trial» — сынақ екі жылға жоспарланған. Тұжырым осыны басқа сөзбен айтады → TRUE.
explanation.ru: «for a two-year trial» — эксперимент рассчитан на два года. Утверждение пересказывает это другими словами → TRUE.

items.quote: The school kept the length of the day the same
items.prompt: Pupils at the school now spend fewer hours in lessons than before the change.

explanation.en: “kept the length of the day the same” — the school day did not get shorter, it only moved. “Fewer hours” contradicts the text → FALSE.
explanation.kk: «kept the length of the day the same» — оқу күні қысқармаған, тек уақыты жылжыған. «Fewer hours» мәтінге қайшы → FALSE.
explanation.ru: «kept the length of the day the same» — учебный день не стал короче, он просто сдвинулся. «Fewer hours» противоречит тексту → FALSE.

items.quote: Sports clubs that used to meet after school were moved to the lunch break, which was made twenty minutes longer
items.prompt: The lunch break was extended so that sports clubs could meet then.

explanation.en: “moved to the lunch break, which was made twenty minutes longer” — “extended” = “made longer”, and the clubs were moved to lunch → TRUE.
explanation.kk: «moved to the lunch break, which was made twenty minutes longer»: «extended» = «made longer», үйірмелер түскі үзіліске ауыстырылған → TRUE.
explanation.ru: «moved to the lunch break, which was made twenty minutes longer» — «extended» = «made longer», клубы перенесли на обед → TRUE.

items.quote: Exam results in mathematics improved slightly, but results in other subjects stayed almost unchanged
items.prompt: Exam results improved in every subject during the first year.

explanation.en: Only mathematics improved; other subjects “stayed almost unchanged”. “Every subject” is a generalisation the text contradicts → FALSE.
explanation.kk: Тек математика жақсарған, қалған пәндер «stayed almost unchanged». «Every subject» — мәтін жоққа шығаратын жалпылау → FALSE.
explanation.ru: Улучшилась только математика, остальные предметы «stayed almost unchanged». «Every subject» — обобщение, которое текст опровергает → FALSE.

items.prompt: Most parents were in favour of the later start.

explanation.en: “Not everyone welcomed the change” and “some parents” show that some were unhappy, but how many parents supported it is not stated. “Not everyone” does not mean “most were against” → NOT GIVEN.
explanation.kk: «Not everyone welcomed the change» және «some parents» — наразылар болған, бірақ ата-аналардың қаншасы қолдағаны айтылмаған. «Not everyone» деген «көпшілігі қарсы» дегенді білдірмейді → NOT GIVEN.
explanation.ru: «Not everyone welcomed the change» и «some parents» — значит, недовольные были, но сколько родителей поддержало перемены, не сказано. «Not everyone» не означает «most were against» → NOT GIVEN.

groups.instruction: Questions 1–5. Do the following statements agree with the information given in the reading passage? Write TRUE if the statement agrees with the information, FALSE if the statement contradicts the information, or NOT GIVEN if there is no information on this.
